biography: Experienced construction and preconstruction professional with a strong technical background in electrical, mechanical, control systems, and telecom, while also managing broader scopes across complex projects. Based in Phoenix, with over a decade of experience leading and supporting major wide range of projects, including infrastructure and mission-critical projects across North America and the Middle East, including data centers, airports, metro -lines, healthcare, and industrial facilities. I work across all phases of project delivery , from estimating, scope definition, and value engineering to trade coordination and field execution. With a deep understanding of integrated systems and field operations, I bring a partnership-driven approach, working closely with trade partners to ensure constructability, reliability, on-time delivery, and quality across every phase of the project.
